basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old outdoor enthusiast from Michigan, recently got into historical firearms and military surplus collecting. I work as an IT support specialist during the day, which gives me a good balance between my tech interests and my passion for history. I'm single and spend my weekends exploring local trails or hitting the range with friends. I usually log into Reddit after work, around 7 PM to 10 PM, and during weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I'm fairly new to the world of historical firearms, especially Mosin Nagants. My knowledge is primarily based on online forums and YouTube videos. I love diving into new hobbies and learning as I go along.
